title: Where the Guest Is Staying and the Daily Figure on an Equipment Rental and Demo Extension
content:
A household still in one of the collective's own beds for the whole of the extension is keeping the kit on the mountain; a household whose stay ends first is taking it away, and the daily figure the extra days are charged at follows that.

## The rule

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season whose departure date falls on or after the date the guest has asked the kit to be kept to, the daily figure is taken at the resident share of itself. The resident share is 80 per cent.

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation for the season whose departure date falls before the date the guest has asked the kit to be kept to, the daily figure is taken at the post stay share of itself instead. The post stay share is 110 per cent.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the daily figure.

## The branches

| Resort Lodging reservation held for the season | Its departure date against the date the kit is asked to be kept to | Share of the daily figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | on it or after it | 80 per cent |
| yes | before it | 110 per cent |
| no | — | nothing under this heading |

A departure date falling on the very date the kit is asked to be kept to sits in the first row, not the second.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical extension

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement whose daily figure stands at 39.00 USD when this heading is reached, and on which the guest has asked for the kit to be kept to the 17th of January.

- The household's lodging reservation shows a departure date of the 20th: the daily figure is 80 per cent of 39.00 USD, which is 31.20 USD.
- The departure date is the 17th: the daily figure is again 80 per cent of 39.00 USD, which is 31.20 USD.
- The departure date is the 15th: the daily figure is 110 per cent of 39.00 USD, which is 42.90 USD.
- The household holds no lodging reservation for the season: nothing under this heading changes the 39.00 USD.

The second of the two shares raises the daily figure rather than lowering it.

## Point of judgement

**Which date on the rental side is read.** The date the guest has asked the kit to be kept to, not the date written on the agreement and not the date the request was raised.
